paragraphs: SOLUS develops digital products for libraries of all sizes, from local branches to library consortiums. Three of the products offered are The Library App, eb#1, and LUCi, which the company describes as working together. The Library App is described as giving patrons mobile access to borrowing, reservations, events, and notifications.

LUCi is the discovery platform and website, uniting catalogue search, account management, events, and content. The events and room booking product, eb#1, covers customizable designs, multiple calendar views, and built-in promotional tools. eb#1 supports over 50 languages as well as left-to-right and right-to-left script.

SOLUS started with public libraries and says its technology now also helps academic institutions. City Of Edinburgh Libraries is named as the first customer after the company turned to mobile technology for libraries. The Libraries Consortium was the first to use the discovery platform. Offices are in Scotland, Australia, and the US, with re-sellers of the app located around the world.
